name: National Plywood Industries Limited
about: National Plywood Industries Limited manufactures and sells plywood, laminates, and other allied products in India. The company offers plywood and block board products, include boiling water proof marine, boiling water resistant, moisture resistant, and flexiply and film faced (shuttering); flush doors; general purpose, post forming, flooring grade, compact, unicolor, fire retardant, marker grade, chalk board, and liner laminates; electrical insulators and phenolic backers; and other allied products comprises fiber cement boards and acrylic solid surfaces. It sells its products under the National Club Plus, National Platinum Club, National Titanium, Pioneer National, National Gold, Prima National, National Bronze, National Film Faced, National Laminart, and Uninational Laminate brands through a network of distributors and dealers. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
